ops.sql: SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type = 'table' AND (name LIKE 't_sec%' OR name = 't_xrefsystem') ORDER BY name
SELECT * FROM t_xrefsystem ORDER BY Type, Client
SELECT UserID, UserLogin, FirstName, Surname FROM t_secuser ORDER BY UserLogin
SELECT Object_ID, Name, ea_guid, Stereotype, Package_ID FROM t_object WHERE Object_Type = 'JavascriptAddin' OR Stereotype = 'JavascriptAddin' ORDER BY Object_ID

SELECT o.Name AS addin, op.Name AS reception, op.StyleEx, s.Object_ID AS local_signal_id, s.Name AS local_signal FROM t_operation op INNER JOIN t_object o ON o.Object_ID = op.Object_ID LEFT JOIN t_object s ON s.Object_Type = 'Signal' AND op.StyleEx LIKE '%' || s.ea_guid || '%' WHERE o.Stereotype = 'JavascriptAddin' AND op.StyleEx LIKE 'Reception%' ORDER BY o.Name, op.Name
